footer.description: Iqonga lokuqala laseKenya le-AI elenzelwe ubuntlola kwezopolitiko. Yakhelwe ukhetho luka-2027.

about.storyP1: Imikhankaso yaseKenya namhlanje iqhutywa sisisa kunye neembono ezivela kubacebisi.
about.storyP2: Abaphumeleleyo kunye nabalahlekileyo bahlala benqulwa ngethamsanqa, hayi ubukrelekrele.
about.storyP4: Sakha inkqubo apho zonke izigqibo zopolitiko zixhaswa bubukrelekrele bokwenyani, obuqhubekayo. hayi ukuqagela.
about.visionText: Iinkokheli zenza izigqibo ngokusekwe kubukrelekrele, hayi ngethamsanqa.
about.p1Desc: Yakhelwe isiSwahili kunye neSheng ukusukela kumhla wokuqala. Ayingomzekelo wesiNgesi owenzelwe iMpuma yeAfrika.
about.p2Desc: Idatha yabagqwesileyo ayisabelwana ngayo. Iphulo ngalinye libona ulwazi lwayo kuphela.
about.p3Desc: Amaxabiso enzelwe ukuba umntu okhethwe okokuqala kwi-MCA angakwazi ukufikelela kwezixhobo zifana nezomkhankaso karhulumente.
about.p4Desc: Singakuvuyela ukubonelela ngengqiqo enye eqinisekisiweyo kunezilingo ezilishumi ezinomsindo.

bios.morris: Ukuqhuba umbono kunye nokukhula kweKampeni. Ukwakha iqonga lokuqala lolwazi lwezopolitiko eKenya lokutshintsha indlela iinkokheli ezenza ngayo izigqibo.
bios.barak: Ukwakha iziseko zophuhliso eziguqula amajelo eendaba aseKenya abe yingqiqo yomkhankaso. Ngaphambili kwakhiwe iinkqubo zedatha kwi-fintechs yaseMpuma Afrika.
bios.albert: Ukuqulunqwa kweqonga eliyintloko - ukusuka kumjelo wedatha kunye neemodeli ze-NLP ukuya kwideshibhodi ethembela kwiikhankaso ntsasa nganye.
bios.john: Ukujonga isicwangciso sezemali sikaKampeni kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba iqonga lilingana ngokuzinzileyo kwilizwe lepolitiki yaseKenya.
bios.anwar: Ukuhola isicwangciso sezopolitiko kunye nolwalamano lwabathengi kwiKenya iphela. Ukunciphisa umsantsa phakathi kwedatha yezobuntlola nezigqibo zokhankaso eziyinyani.

contact.eaDesc: Yiba phakathi kweenkokheli zopolitiko zokuqala eKenya ukufikelela kwiqonga leKampeni. Iindawo ezilinganiselweyo ziyafumaneka.
contact.partnerDesc: Ii-NGO, iifemu zokuphanda, iinkampani zosasazo - masijonge ukuba yintoni esinokuyakha kunye.
contact.footerTagline: Umjikelo wokhetho olandelayo uqala ngoku. Hlala phambili.

features.headerSubtitle: Iimodyuli ezine zobuntlola zisebenzisana  ke umkhankaso wakho usoloko unolwazi olungcono kunalowo ukhoyo egumbini.
features.ctaSubtitle: Cela ukufikelela kwangoko okanye ujonge iqonga eliphilayo.
features.f1Sub: Yazi ukuba yintoni abavoti bakho abayikhathaleleyo njengoko kusenzeka
features.f1b1: Landelela iimvakalelo kwiimidiya zentlalo, iindaba kunye neengxelo zentsimi
features.f1b2: Jonga imiba ephakamayo ngaphambi kokuba ibe ziingxaki
features.f1b3: Gxininisa kuphela kwimixholo echukumisa ngokwenene abavoti
features.f2Sub: Hlala phambi kwayo yonke intshukumo yomchasi
features.f2b1: Jonga zonke izitatimende zoluntu kunye nokuvela kweendaba
features.f2b3: Ukuvelisa izicwangciso zokulwa ezisekwe kwiinyani kwimizuzwana
features.f3Sub: Ukuchitha phi ukufumana isixa esiphezulu sokubuya kwevoti
features.f4Sub: Ukulawula ngokuzithemba kwaye ucwangcise ukukhethwa kwakho kwakhona kwangethuba
features.f4b2: Jonga imiba yamazwe ngamazwe ngeWhatsApp kunye neeSMS
features.f4b3: Fumana izilumkiso kwangethuba malunga nokuncipha kwesigunyaziso kunye nemingcipheko yezopolitiko

media.headerSubtitle: Yonke into iintatheli kunye neengcali zosasazo ezifuna ukupapasha iKampeni.
media.r1Desc: Iifomathi ze-PNG, i-SVG kunye neevetha kwiinguqu zombala ezininzi.
media.r2Desc: Izithombe eziphezulu kunye neefoto zeqela zokusetyenziswa kweendaba.
media.r3Desc: Imvelaphi yenkampani, inkcazo yemveliso kunye nezikhokelo zorhwebo.
media.quote: "Ixesha elizayo lezopolitiko laseKenya lelaba nkokhokelayo abathatha izigqibo ngokusekwe kwidatha, hayi uqikelelo olufundisiweyo."
